AMath 585 Notebooks

AMath 585, Winter Quarter 2020 at the University of Washington. Developed by R.J. LeVeque and distributed under the BSD license. You are free to modify and use as you please, with attribution.

These notebooks are all available on Github.

Introductory notebooks

  • Demo1.ipynb
  • Debugging_hints.ipynb
  • Numpy_array_hints.ipynb Some notes on indexing and slicing, and mutable objects

Finite difference approximations

  • fdstencil.ipynb Computing finite difference coefficients
  • fdstencil_errors.ipynb Testing two approximations to u''(\bar x)

2-point boundary values problems

  • Banded.ipynb Tips on working with banded matrices
  • BVP_stability.ipynb Compute banded matrices for u''(x)=f(x) and investigate inverse matrix and max-norm stability.
  • BVP1.ipynb Solve u''(x) = f(x) with Dirichlet BCs and test on a manufactured solution
  • BVP_nonlinear.ipynb Solve \epsilon u''(x) + u(x)(u'(x) - 1) = f(x) using Newton iteration
  • BVP_layer.ipynb Solve \epsilon u''(x) + u(x)(u'(x) - 1) = f(x) in the singularly perturbed case
  • BVP_scipy.ipynb Illustrate use of scipy.integrate.solve_bvp

Function space methods

  • FourierSpectral.ipynb Introduction to Discrete Fourier Transform and use in solving a BVP with periodic boundary conditions.
  • ChebPolyOnCircle.ipynb Illustrates the relation between Chebyshev polynomials and Fourier series, with some discussion of aliasing in both cases.
  • ChebyshevSpectral.ipynb Illustrates Chebyshev interpolation and using to to obtain a spectrally accurate approximation to a derivative.

Sparse matrix solvers

  • Grids2D.ipynb Defining and plotting functions on a 2D grid.
  • LaplacianMatrix.ipynb Converting 2D grid functions to vectors,creating 5-point Laplacian matrix using Kronecker products.
  • IterativeMethods.ipynb Illustrates the classic matrix spitting methods: Jacobi, Gauss-Seidel, and SOR.
  • ConjugateGradient.ipynb Illustration of C-G algorithm on 1D BVP.
  • ConjugateGradient2D.ipynb Illustration of C-G algorithm on a 2D Poisson problem.
  • ConjugateGradient2D_vcoeff.ipynb Illustration of C-G algorithm on a 2D variable coefficient elliptic equation.
  • PCG.ipynb Preconditioned conjugate gradients, with corrections to the text.
  • DarcyFlow.ipynb An example application - flow through porous media solved with PCG.
  • Multigrid.ipynb Illustration of some key ideas used in multigrid methods.
